title: 第十四章 夜战第十五章 归程
content_zh:
夜色如墨，月光被厚厚的云层遮住，大地一片漆黑。
驿站外三百丈处，十五个黑影在黑暗中无声潜行。他们的脚步极轻，踩在落叶上几乎没有声响，每个人的呼吸都压到了最低，只有衣袂摩擦的细微沙沙声在夜风中若隐若现。
领头的是个身材瘦削的男人，一身黑衣紧贴身体，脸上戴着一张白色面具，面具上画着一只栩栩如生的黑蝎。他的身形如同一道幽灵，在黑暗中忽隐忽现，速度快得惊人。
筑基境三重。
此人名叫苏冷，黑蝎青州分舵甲级杀手小队队长，绰号“寒刃”。他的兵器是一对短匕，薄如蝉翼，锋利无比，据说曾经在三息之内割断过一个筑基境二重高手的喉咙。
苏冷身后跟着十四个人，清一色的凝气境五重以上。
这样的阵容，放在青州城任何一家势力面前，都是一股不可忽视的力量。他们接到的任务很简单——截杀方圆和王紫璇，死活不论，但人头必须带回去。
苏冷不喜欢这种任务。他喜欢杀高手，杀那些能跟他正面交锋的强者。杀两个十几岁的孩子，对他来说没有任何成就感。
但任务就是任务。两千灵石已经到账，尾款三千等他交人头的时候结。
五千灵石买两个人的命，这在青州分舵的历史上都不多见。
“队长。”身后一个黑衣人低声开口，“前面就是驿站。刚才探子回报，目标在驿站内，和龙门镖局的人在一起。”
“龙门镖局？”苏冷眉头微皱，“赵铁山也在？”
“在。还有他手下的十三个镖师。”
苏冷沉默了片刻。
赵铁山他听说过，凝气境九重巅峰，在青州镖行里算一号人物。不过凝气境九重在他这个筑基境三重面前，也就是多费几刀的事。
至于那些镖师，更是不值一提。
“按原计划。”苏冷下令，“包围驿站，不留活口。”
十五道黑影散开，如一张大网从四面八方罩向驿站。
苏冷一马当先，几个起落便掠到了驿站外墙边。他的灵识像一张无形的网，覆盖了整个驿站——屋内有三十二个人的气息，其中十四个普通人（驿站老板和几个商队的人），其余十八个都是武者。
目标二人的气息很清晰：一个凝气境一重，一个凝气境七重。

苏冷嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
他打了个手势，示意手下人行动。
十四名黑衣人翻过院墙，无声无息地落入驿站院内。
然而在他们落地的瞬间——
院子里的火把突然全部亮了起来！
不是被风吹亮的，而是有人同时点燃了所有的火把。
火光冲天，将院子照得如同白昼！
苏冷的瞳孔猛地一缩。
院子里空无一人。
不，不是空无一人——院子里确实没有人，但那十四名黑衣人落地的位置，地面上画满了红色的纹路。
阵纹。
苏冷的脸瞬间变了颜色：“退！！！”
晚了。
方圆的身影出现在屋顶上。
他双手结印，一掌拍在屋顶的瓦片上。
“启！”
阵纹一瞬间全部亮了起来，红色的光芒从地面冲天而起，将十四名黑衣人全部笼罩其中！那些阵纹像是活了，像一条条红色的蛇，顺着黑衣人的脚踝迅速向上攀爬，缠住他们的双腿、手臂、腰身。
十四个人，全部被定在原地，动弹不得！
这是什么阵法？！苏冷从未见过如此诡异的阵纹——它不是攻击型的阵法，而是困阵，专门限制行动。而且阵法的力量极强，连凝气境七重的杀手都挣脱不了！
方圆站在屋顶上，月光和火光映照在他的白衣上，光影交错。他俯视着院中被困的十四名黑衣人，目光冰冷。

这个阵法，是他在前世的记忆中翻出来的一个最简单的小型困阵——名为“缚灵阵”。只需要提前画好阵纹，用灵石作为能量源，就能在短时间内困住修为低于布阵者一个大境界的敌人。
他不是阵法大师，但前世活了三百年的见识，随手画一个最基础的困阵还是没问题的。
苏冷是筑基境三重，缚灵阵困不住他。但他的手下——十四名凝气境五重到七重的杀手——全部中招。
“赵总镖头。”方圆淡淡开口。
“在！”
content_en:
The night was as dark as ink, the moonlight was blocked by thick clouds, and the earth was pitch black.
Three hundred feet outside the inn, fifteen black figures were sneaking silently in the darkness. Their steps were so light that there was almost no sound when they stepped on the fallen leaves. Everyone's breathing was suppressed to the lowest level. Only the slight rustle of their clothes was faintly heard in the night wind.
The leader was a thin man, wearing black clothes that clung to his body, and a white mask on his face, with a lifelike black scorpion painted on the mask. His figure was like a ghost, flickering in and out of the darkness at an alarming speed.
The third level of foundation building realm.
This person's name is Su Leng, the captain of the Black Scorpion Qingzhou Branch's Class A killer team, nicknamed "Han Blade". His weapons are a pair of short daggers, as thin as cicada wings and extremely sharp. It is said that he once cut the throat of a second-level master of the Foundation Establishment Realm within three breaths.
Su Leng was followed by fourteen people, all of whom were at level five or above of the Qi Condensation Realm.
Such a lineup is a force that cannot be ignored in front of any force in Qingzhou City. The mission they received was simple - intercept and kill Fangyuan and Wang Zixuan, regardless of life or death, but their heads must be taken back.
Su Leng didn't like this kind of task. He likes to kill masters, those who can fight head-on with him. Killing two teenage children gave him no sense of accomplishment.
But a mission is a mission. Two thousand spiritual stones have arrived, and the remaining balance of three thousand will be settled when he pays the head.
Five thousand spirit stones can buy two lives, which is rare in the history of Qingzhou branch.
"Captain." A man in black behind him spoke in a low voice, "In front is the inn. The spy reported just now that the target is in the inn, with the people from the Longmen Escort Bureau."
"Longmen Escort Agency?" Su Leng frowned slightly, "Zhao Tieshan is here too?"
"Yes. There are also thirteen bodyguards under him."
Su Leng was silent for a moment.
He had heard that Zhao Tieshan was at the ninth level of the Qi Condensation Realm and was considered the number one figure in the Qingzhou escort agency. However, in front of him, the ninth level of the Qi Condensation Realm, the third level of the Foundation Establishment Realm, it would only cost a few more swords.
As for those escorts, they are not worth mentioning.
"According to the original plan." Su Leng ordered, "Surround the inn and leave no survivors."
Fifteen black shadows spread out, like a big net covering the inn from all directions.
Su Leng took the lead, and after a few ups and downs, he reached the outer wall of the inn. His spiritual consciousness was like an invisible net, covering the entire inn - there were thirty-two people in the room, fourteen of whom were ordinary people (the inn owner and a few people from the caravan), and the remaining eighteen were warriors.
The auras of the two targets are very clear: one is at the first level of Qi Condensation Realm, and the other is at the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm.
Su Leng's lips curved into a sneer.
He gestured for his men to take action.
Fourteen men in black climbed over the courtyard wall and fell silently into the courtyard of the inn.
However, the moment they landed——
All the torches in the yard suddenly lit up!
They were not lit by the wind, but someone lit all the torches at the same time.
The fire soared into the sky, illuminating the yard like daylight!
Su Leng's pupils shrank suddenly.
The yard was deserted.
No, it's not empty - there is indeed no one in the yard, but where the fourteen men in black landed, the ground is covered with red lines.
Formation pattern.
Su Leng's face changed color instantly: "Back!!!"
It's late.
Fangyuan's figure appeared on the roof.
He formed a seal with his hands and slapped his palm on the roof tiles.
"Kai!"
All the array patterns lit up in an instant, and red light rose from the ground to the sky, covering all fourteen men in black! Those formation patterns seemed to be alive, like red snakes, quickly climbing up the ankles of the men in black, wrapping around their legs, arms, and waists.
Fourteen people were all locked in place, unable to move!
What formation is this? ! Su Leng had never seen such a strange formation - it was not an attacking formation, but a trapping formation, specifically restricting movement.move. Moreover, the power of the formation is so strong that not even a killer at the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm can break free!
Fangyuan stood on the roof, the moonlight and firelight reflected on his white clothes, the light and shadow intertwined. He looked down at the fourteen men in black trapped in the courtyard with cold eyes.
This formation is the simplest small-scale trapping formation that he found in the memory of his previous life - called "Spirit Binding Formation". You only need to draw the formation pattern in advance and use spirit stones as the energy source to trap enemies whose cultivation level is one level lower than that of the person setting up the formation in a short period of time.
He is not a master of formations, but he has the experience of living for three hundred years in his previous life, and it is no problem to draw the most basic trapping formation casually.
Su Leng was at the third level of the Foundation Establishment Realm, so the spirit-binding formation could not trap him. But his men—fourteen killers at the fifth to seventh levels of the Qi Condensation Realm—were all hit.
"Mr. Zhao, head escort." Fang Yuan said calmly.
"exist!"
